game.title: Mafia: The Old Country
game.blurb: Story-driven crime action-adventure set in 1900s Sicily, from Hangar 13, released 2025-08-08. RAWG average playtime: 16 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

notes: Backlog game, added from the docs/PLAN.md candidate list. StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); its Walkthrough is linked but not written. mafiagame.fandom.com answers the API, with about 57 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Nero" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 1941540. 26 of 62 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder.
